description: This file defines functions to import CSS files, concatenate and minify CSS sources, and dynamically inject CSS into a web page by creating style elements with JavaScript. It serves as a utility module for handling and injecting CSS in a web or server environment.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Reads a file's content from the specified path.

methods.name: luax.css
methods.description: Concatenates and minifies multiple CSS sources, then injects the resulting CSS into the document by creating a style element.
